<!-- lemma-44: body_md -->
\label{prop:BarrierSecGWPropUBold}
For any $k<n_{\varepsilon}$,  $z \in [0,100k]$ and all $j  \geq 0$,
                             
\begin{align}
M_{1} &:= \mathbb{P}\left( \eta^{\,\langle z \rangle}_\ell \ge \alpha(\ell), \, 1 < \ell < k; \,  \eta^{\,\langle z \rangle}_k \in I_{\alpha(k)+j} \right) \nonumber \\ 
\label{18.20}
& \leq  C e^{-2k-2z-2k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\varepsilon}}+2j} (1+z+ k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\varepsilon}}) (1+j) k_{n_\varepsilon}^{-1/2}
e^{-\frac{\left( z  - j \right)^{2}}{8k}}.
\end{align}
<!-- end lemma-44 -->
<!-- proof-53: body_md -->
The value $M_1$ is the probability which is bounded in \cite[Lemma 8.1]{BRZ2},  apart from
our shift of $\varpi_{\varepsilon} \in [0,1)$ at level $\mathsf {K}^\star_{2}$,  see (\ref{dr.1}),  and replacing 
$\mathsf{s}_0(z)$ by $\mathsf{s}_1(z)=\mathsf{s}_0(z-\boldsymbol{\rho}_\varepsilon)$,  see (\ref{eq:nominal}),  both of which are easily accommodated 
by increasing the constant $C$ in (\ref{18.20}).  Where the proof of \cite[Lemma 8.1]{BRZ2} 
refers to \cite[Theorem 1.1]{BRZ},  a factor of the form $\sqrt{\frac{\alpha(0)+z}{(\alpha(k)+j)k}}$ 
has been left out.  Over our range of $z$ and $j$,  the missing factor is uniformly bounded by $c k_{n_\varepsilon}^{-1/2}$,  
which we have thus included in (\ref{18.20}).
<!-- end proof-53 -->
<!-- remark-21: body_md -->
\label{rmk:a-vep-s1} Hereafter,  we ignore the effects 
of our $\varpi_{\varepsilon}$ fractional shift and that of replacing $\mathsf{s}_0(z)$ by $\mathsf{s}_1(z)$,  since 
the same rational as in the proceeding proof applies to all our barrier estimates.
<!-- end remark-21 -->
<!-- lemma-45: body_md -->
\label{prop:BarrierSecGWPropUB}
For any $s<\frac{1}{2} n_{\varepsilon}<k<n_{\varepsilon}$,  $u \in [-s^{\kappa_o}, 100k]$ and all $  j  \geq 0$, 
                
\begin{eqnarray}
&&
K_{1}\,:=\mathbb{P}\left(\alpha (  \ell) \le  \sqrt{2T_{\ell}^{{\bf 0},s, r_{ u}}},\,s<\ell<k;\,  \sqrt{2T_{k}^{0,s, r_{ u}}}\in I_{\alpha (k)+j}\right)\nonumber\\
&&\nonumber
\leq c  \left(1+ u\right)\left(1+ j\right) \nonumber\\
&&\hspace{1 in}\times e^{-2(k-s)-2\(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)+2(j-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} )} e^{-\frac{\left( \(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)-(j-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} )\right)^{2}}{4(k-s)}}.\label{18.20bend}
\end{eqnarray}
              
Equivalently,  
\begin{align}
K_1 & := \mathbb{P}\left(\eta^{\langle u \rangle,s}_l \ge \alpha(\ell) \,,  s<\ell<k;\, \eta^{\langle u \rangle,s}_k  \in I_{\alpha(k)+k_{n_\varepsilon}^{\kappa_o}+j}\right)\nonumber\\
&\leq C e^{-2(k-s)-2u+2j}
 \left(1+u+ s^{{\kappa_o}} \right)\left(1+ j+   k_{n_{\varepsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}\right)  e^{-\frac{\left( u-j\right)^{2}}{4(k-s)}}    \,.
\label{18.20bendj1}
\end{align}
\noindent
(a).  If in addition $k-s \geq c n_{\varepsilon}$ then the {\sc\lowercase{rhs}} is multiplied by $k^{-1/2}_{n_{\varepsilon}}$.\\
(b).  For $s<k<\frac{1}{2} n_{\varepsilon}$,  the {\sc\lowercase{rhs}} is further multiplied by $(k-s)^{-1/2}$.\\
(c).  If $\frac{1}{2} n_{\varepsilon} \leq s<k$ we replace the $s^{{\kappa_o}}$ in (\ref{18.20bendj1}) by
$s^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_\varepsilon}$ and multiply 
the {\sc\lowercase{rhs}} by $\sqrt{\frac{x}{y (k-s)}}$,  where $x=\boldsymbol{\rho}_{\varepsilon} (n_\varepsilon-s) +u$ and $y=\boldsymbol{\rho}_\varepsilon (n_\varepsilon-k)+j$.\\
(d).  In all cases, if $(k-s)\log (n_{\varepsilon})/n_{\varepsilon}\leq c$ we get an additional factor of $(k-s)^{-1}$.
<!-- end lemma-45 -->
<!-- proof-54: body_md -->
Recall that we 
 denote by 
 $T_{l}, l=0,1,2,\ldots$ the critical Galton--Watson process
with geometric distribution, and let $P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_n$ denote its law when 
$T_0=n$. 

a) Consider first the case where $s\leq n_{\epsilon}/2\leq k\leq n_{\epsilon}$.
Let
\begin{equation}
v=\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}(n_{\epsilon}-k)- k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}.
         
\end{equation}
 We rewrite $K_{1} $  as
 \begin{eqnarray}
&&
K_{1}=P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_{r_{ u}} \left(\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}(n_{\epsilon}-s-l)- \(s+l \)^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\le  \sqrt{2T_{l} } \mbox{\,\ for }l=1,\ldots, k-s-1;\right.\nonumber\\ 
&&\left.\hspace{2in}\sqrt{2T_{k-s} }\in  I_{v+j}  \right).\label{18.22}
\end{eqnarray}


We show below  that for any $0<{\kappa_o}<1$, and all $1\leq l\leq k-1$
\begin{equation}
\(s+l \)_{n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}} \leq k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}+\frac{\(s^{{\kappa_o}}-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)}{k-s}((k-s)-l)+l^{{\kappa_o}}_{k-s},\qquad l=1,\ldots, k-s,\label{bent.1a}
\end{equation}
                 
                                                      
               
from which it follows that
\begin{eqnarray}
&&\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}(n_{\epsilon}-s-l)- \(s+l \)^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\label{bar.64}\\
&& \ge \rho_{n_{\epsilon}}(n_{\epsilon}-k)- k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}+\(\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}-\frac{\(s^{{\kappa_o}}-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)}{k-s} \) ( (k-s)-l) -  l^{{\kappa_o}}_{k-s}\nonumber\\
&&=v+\(\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}-\frac{\(s^{{\kappa_o}}-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)}{k-s} \) ( (k-s)-l) -  l^{{\kappa_o}}_{k-s}.\nonumber
\end{eqnarray}
Hence if we let
\begin{equation}
\rho_{n_{\epsilon},s,k}=\(\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}-\frac{\(s^{{\kappa_o}}-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)}{k-s} \)
          
\end{equation}
 we have
\begin{eqnarray}
&&  K_{1}\leq P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_{r_{ u}}\left(v+\rho_{n_{\epsilon},s,k}( (k-s)-l) -  l^{{\kappa_o}}_{k-s}\le\sqrt{2T_{l}},\right.\nonumber\\
&&\left.\hspace{1 in} l=1,\ldots,k-s-1;\sqrt{2T_{k-s}}\in  I_{v+  j}  \right),
\end{eqnarray}
and                      
\begin{equation}
\sqrt{2r_{ u}} =\alpha (s)+u=\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}(n_{\epsilon}-s)- s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}+u=\rho_{n_{\epsilon},s,k}  (k-s)+v+ u.
\end{equation}

Thus using  \cite[Theorem 1.1]{BRZ},   with $a=\rho_{n_{\epsilon},s,k}  (k-s) +v, x=\sqrt{2r_{ u}}$ and $b=v, y=v+  j$,
\begin{eqnarray}
&&
K_{1}\leq  c\frac{\left(1+ u\right)\left(1+ j\right)}{(k-s)}\sqrt{\frac{x}{y (k-s)}}\nonumber\\
&&\hspace{1 in}
\exp\{-\frac{\left(\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}  (k-s)+ u+  (k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}- s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})- j \right)^{2}}{2(k-s)}\},\nonumber
\end{eqnarray}
We write out
\begin{eqnarray}
  &&\hspace{.3 in}
\left(\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}  (k-s)+ (u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(j-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} ) \right)^{2}/2(k-s)
\label{multdef.11}\\
&& = \left(2(k-s)+ (u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(j-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} ) -(k-s)\log (n_{\epsilon})/2n_{\epsilon}\right)^{2}/2(k-s) \nonumber\\
&&=2(k-s)+ 2((u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(j-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} )) -(k-s)\log (n_{\epsilon})/n_{\epsilon} 
 \nonumber \\
 &&\hspace{.5 in}
+ \left( (u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(j-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} ) -(k-s)\log (n_{\epsilon})/2n_{\epsilon}\right)^{2}/2(k-s). \nonumber
\end{eqnarray}
Using the concavity of the logarithm, we have $(k-s)\log (n_{\epsilon})/n_{\epsilon} \leq \log (k-s)$, and using $(a-b)^{2}\geq a^{2}/2-b^{2}$ we see that 
\begin{eqnarray}
&&\left( (u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(j-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} ) -(k-s)\log (n_{\epsilon})/2n_{\epsilon}\right)^{2}/2(k-s)\nonumber\\
&&\geq  ((u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(j-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} ))^{2} /4(k-s)-o_{n_{\epsilon}}(1).\label{multdef.12}
\end{eqnarray}

Also, if $k-s\geq c n_{\epsilon}$, since $\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}  (n_{\epsilon}-k) -k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}   \geq c (n_{\epsilon}-k)$ we have
\begin{equation}
\sqrt{\frac{x}{y (k-s)}}\leq \sqrt{\frac{c}{  (n_{\epsilon}-k)}}=\frac{c}{k^{1/2}_{n_{\epsilon}}}.\label{bent.7}
\end{equation}

 It follows that 
 \begin{eqnarray}
 &&
K_{1}\leq c \frac{\left(1+u \right)\left(1+ j\right)}{k^{1/2}_{n_{\epsilon}}}\nonumber\\
&&\times e^{-2(k-s)-2\(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)+2(j-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} )} e^{-\frac{\left( \(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)-(j-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} )\right)^{2}}{4(k-s)}}.\nonumber
\end{eqnarray}



b) If $s<k<n_{\epsilon}/2$,  we use \Cref{lem-bend1} to obtain the analog of (\ref{bent.1a}) for any $0<{\kappa_o}\leq 1$: 
\begin{equation}
\(s+l \)^{{\kappa_o}} \leq k^{ {\kappa_o}}+\frac{\(s^{{\kappa_o}}-k^{ {\kappa_o}}\)}{k-s}((k-s)-l)+l^{{\kappa_o}}_{k-s},\qquad l=1,\ldots, k-s,
\label{bent.1b}
\end{equation}
and proceed as before.
$\sqrt{\frac{x}{y (k-s)}}$ gives the factor of $(k-s)^{-1/2}$.

c) If $n_{\epsilon}/2\leq s<k$,  we use  \Cref{lem-bend1}  to obtain the analog of (\ref{bent.1a}) for any $0<{\kappa_o}\leq 1$: 
\begin{equation}
\(s+l \)^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} \leq k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}+\frac{\(s^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)}{k-s}((k-s)-l)+l^{{\kappa_o}}_{k-s},\qquad l=1,\ldots, k-s,
\label{bent.1c}
\end{equation}
and proceed as before. We retain the factor
$\sqrt{\frac{x}{y (k-s)}}$.
<!-- end proof-54 -->
<!-- lemma-46: body_md -->
\label{lem-bendc}
For any   $s<n_{\epsilon}/2<k\leq n_{\epsilon}$ and all $  v  \geq 0$, with 
$s\log n_{\epsilon}/n_{\epsilon}\leq c$,   and $|z| \leq \log n_{\epsilon}$ with $t_{z}\in \mathbb{N}$,     and $3s<k$ then
\begin{align}
L_{1,v}\,:=& \mathbb{P}\Big(\eta^{\,\langle z \rangle}_l \ge \alpha(l) ,\,s \le l \le k;\,  \eta^{\,\langle z \rangle}_k  \in I_{\alpha(k)+v}\Big) \nonumber \\
\label{18.20srgbend}
&  \leq  ce^{-2k-2z+2(v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})} \left(1+\sqrt{s}+z_{+}\right)\left(1+v \right)e^{-\frac{\left(z-(v-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} ) \right)^{2}}{8(k-s)}}.
\end{align}
\begin{comment}
            
             
                                                                                                      
                     
                                                                                                                                     
            
\end{comment}
If in addition $k-s\geq c n_{\epsilon}$ then the right hand side is multiplied by $k^{-1/2}_{n_{\epsilon}}$.

If $s<k<n_{\epsilon}/2$, a similar result holds with the right hand side  multiplied by $(k-s)^{-1/2}$.

In either case, if $(k-s)\log (n_{\epsilon})/n_{\epsilon}\leq c$ we get an additional factor of $(k-s)^{-1}$.
<!-- end lemma-46 -->
<!-- proof-55: body_md -->
We have
\begin{eqnarray}
&&\hspace{.6 in}L_{1,v} \leq \sum_{u=10 n_{\epsilon}}^{\infty}P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_{t_{z}}\left( \sqrt{2T_{s}}\in I_{\alpha (s)+u}\right)\label{18.34b}\\
&&\hspace{.6 in}+\sum_{u=0}^{10 n_{\epsilon}}P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_{t_{z}}\left( \sqrt{2T_{s}}\in I_{\alpha (s)+u}\right) \times \,\, \nonumber\\
&&\hspace{-.3 in} \mathbb{P}\Big(\alpha (   l) \le  \sqrt{2T_{l}^{0,(\alpha (s)+u)^{2}/2}},l=s+1,\ldots,k-1;  \sqrt{2T_{k}^{0, (\alpha (s)+u)^{2}/2}}\in I_{\alpha (k)+v}\Big).\nonumber
\end{eqnarray}
By (\ref{18.20bend}) the second term is bounded by 
\begin{eqnarray}
&& \sum_{u=0}^{10 n_{\epsilon}}P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_{t_{z}}\left( \sqrt{2T_{s}}\in I_{\alpha (s)+u}\right)\times \left(1+u\right)\left(1+ v\right) \nonumber\\
&&\hspace{1 in}\times e^{-2(k-s)-2\(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)+2(v-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} )} e^{-\frac{\left( \(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)-(v-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} )\right)^{2}}{4(k-s)}}.    \label{18.20srg1}
\end{eqnarray}
By \cite[Proposition 1.4, Remark 2.2]{BRZ} and using $s\log n_{\epsilon}/n_{\epsilon}\leq c$,
\begin{eqnarray}
&&P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_{t_{z}}\left( \sqrt{2T_{s}}\in I_{\alpha (s)+u}\right)\label{180.20sr2}\\
&&\leq  c\sqrt{\frac{\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}n_{\epsilon}+z}{(\alpha (s)+u)s}}\,\,e^{-\(\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}s+(z-\(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\))\)^{2}/2s}\nonumber\\
&&\leq  c\frac{1}{\sqrt{s}}\,\,e^{-2s-2(z-\(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\))- (z-\(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\))^{2}/4s}.\nonumber
\end{eqnarray}

Thus we have that (\ref{18.20srg1}) is bounded by 
\begin{eqnarray}
&&  c\sum_{u=0}^{10 n_{\epsilon}}e^{-2k -2z+2(v-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} )}\left(1+u \right)\left(1+ v\right)
\\
&&\times  \frac{1}{\sqrt{s}}\,\,e^{-\frac{\left( \(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)-(v-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} )\right)^{2}}{4(k-s)}} e^{- (z-\(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\))^{2}/4s}.  \nonumber
\end{eqnarray}

Using $(a-b)^{2}\geq a^{2}/2-b^{2}$ with $a=z-(v-k_{n_\epsilon}^{\kappa_o})$ and $b=z-(u-s_{n_\epsilon}^{\kappa_o})$,  and $2s< k-s$, we have
\begin{equation}
e^{-\frac{\left( \(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\)-(v-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} )\right)^{2}}{4(k-s)}} e^{- (z-\(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\))^{2}/4s}
                                                                                                                                                              
\leq  e^{-\frac{\left(z-(v-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} ) \right)^{2}}{8(k-s)}} e^{- (z-\(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\))^{2}/8s}.
\end{equation}
Then 
\begin{equation}
\sum_{u}  \left(1+u \right)  \frac{ e^{- (z-\(u  - s^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\))^{2}/8s}}{\sqrt{s}}
                                                                                                 
 \leq c   \left(1+\sqrt{s}+z_{+}\right)\label{180.25mm}
\end{equation}
Putting this together we see that the second term in (\ref{18.34b}) is bounded by the right hand side of 
(\ref{18.20srgbend}).

 
 On the other hand, as in (\ref{180.20sr2}) we can bound the first term
 \begin{equation}
 \sum_{m=10 n_{\epsilon}}^{\infty}P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_{t_{z}}\left( \sqrt{2T_{s}}\in I_{\alpha (s)+m}\right)\leq c e^{-10 n_{\epsilon}}
 \end{equation}
 which is negligible.
<!-- end proof-55 -->
<!-- lemma-47: body_md -->
\label{lem-bendd}
 Let $s<n_{\epsilon}/2<k\leq n_{\epsilon}$. Under the conditions of the previous Lemma for and $s,k,z$,  if we also skip the barrier from  from $ k$ to $k_{+}=k+ r$, with 
$r\log n_{\epsilon}/n_{\epsilon}\leq c$,    then
\begin{align}
&L_{2}\,:=\mathbb{P}\left(\eta^{\,\langle z \rangle}_l \ge \alpha(l) , \, s \le l \le k;\,  \eta^{\,\langle z \rangle}_{k_+} \in I_{\alpha(k_+)+w} \right)\nonumber\\
\label{18.20srbend}
&\leq  ce^{-2k_{+}-2z-2k^{{\kappa_o}}_{+,n_{\epsilon}}+2w}
 \left(1+\sqrt{s}+z_{+}\right)\left(1+w^{2}+r  \right)e^{  -\frac{(z-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}))^{2}}{16\bar k}}.
\end{align}
<!-- end lemma-47 -->
<!-- proof-56: body_md -->
Using (\ref{18.20srgbend}) we have
\begin{eqnarray}
&&  L_{2}   =\sum_{v=0}^{\infty} L_{1,v} \,\,\,P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_{\(\alpha (k)+v\)^{2}/2}\left( \sqrt{2T_{r}}\in I_{\alpha (k_{+})+w}\right)
\label{180.20t2b}\\
&&   \leq  ce^{-2k-2z+2(v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})} \times  \left(1+\sqrt{s}+z_{+}\right)\left(1+v \right)e^{-\frac{\left(z-(v-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} ) \right)^{2}}{8(k-s)}}  \nonumber\\
&&\hspace{1 in}  P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_{\(\alpha (k)+v\)^{2}/2}\left( \sqrt{2T_{r}}\in I_{\alpha (k_{+})+w}\right).\nonumber 
\end{eqnarray}

By \cite[Proposition 1.4, Remark 2.2]{BRZ} and using $r\log n_{\epsilon}/n_{\epsilon}\leq c$,
\begin{eqnarray}
&& P^{\mbox{\fontsize{.03in}{1in}\rm GW}}_{\(\alpha (k)+v\)^{2}/2}\left( \sqrt{2T_{r}}\in I_{\alpha (k_{+})+w}\right)\label{180.20t2}\\
&&\leq  c\sqrt{\frac{\alpha (k)+v}{(\alpha (k_{+})+w)r}}\,\,e^{-\(\rho_{n_{\epsilon}}r+(v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}})\)^{2}/2r}\nonumber\\
&&\leq  c\frac{(1+v)}{\sqrt{r}}\,\,e^{-2r-2(v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})+2(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}})- ((v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}))^{2}/4r}.\nonumber
\end{eqnarray}

Combined with (\ref{180.20t2b}) we see that
\begin{eqnarray}
&&  L_{2}   \leq  ce^{-2k_{+}-2z+2(w-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{+, n_{\epsilon}})}   \left(1+\sqrt{s}+z_{+}\right)\frac{(1+v)^{2}}{\sqrt{r}}
\label{180.20t4b}\\
&& \times  e^{-\frac{\left(z-(v-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} ) \right)^{2}}{8(k-s)}} \,e^{-((v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}))^{2}/4r}. \nonumber
\end{eqnarray}






                                                                                                                   
Since  $(a-b)^{2}\geq a^{2}/2-b^{2}$ and   $k>r $, we have
\begin{eqnarray}
&&e^{-\frac{\left(z-(v-k^{ {\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}} ) \right)^{2}}{8(k-s)}} \,e^{-((v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}))^{2}/4r}\label{180.25f}\\
&&\leq e^{  -\frac{(( z-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}))-( (v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}))) ^{2}}{8k}}  \,e^{-((v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}))^{2}/4r}\nonumber\\
&&\leq e^{  -\frac{(z-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}))^{2}}{16\bar k}}\,e^{-((v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}))^{2}/8r}.\nonumber
\end{eqnarray}


We then  bound
\begin{equation}
\sum_{v=0}^{\infty}\left(1+v^{2}   \right)\frac{e^{-((v-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}})-(w-k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}))^{2}/8r}}{\sqrt{r}}\leq c\(1+w^{2}+(k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}-k^{{\kappa_o}}_{+,n_{\epsilon}})^{2}+r\).
\end{equation}

Using the bound $k^{{\kappa_o}}_{n_{\epsilon}}\leq (n_{\epsilon}-k)^{{\kappa_o}}\leq k_{+,n_{\epsilon}}^{{\kappa_o}}+r^{{\kappa_o}} $ we obtain
(\ref{18.20srbend}).
<!-- end proof-56 -->
